description: A taxpayer is preparing to file and needs to assemble scattered documents from payroll, banks, brokerage accounts, and freelance platforms before any actual filing work can begin. All institutions and document issuers are fictional.

user_profile.persona: 33-year-old marketing contractor with a mix of employment and side income
user_profile.context: Last year filing was delayed because key forms and receipts were spread across too many inboxes and folders
user_profile.communication_style: Methodical and slightly stressed, wants a complete document checklist with grouping logic

fact_sheet.fact: Alex Chen's Form W-2 for the 2023 tax year from employer Stellar Marketing Solutions was made available on January 25, 2024, in their 'WorkDay' employee portal.
The W-2 from Stellar Marketing Solutions shows total wages of $85,250.50 in Box 1 and federal income tax withheld of $12,787.58 in Box 2.
Alex's Employee ID at Stellar Marketing Solutions is SM-8842, which is required for some portal logins.
Innovatech Dynamics paid Alex Chen a total of $15,600 in 2023 for contract marketing services.
The Form 1099-NEC from Innovatech Dynamics was sent via email as a password-protected PDF on January 29, 2024, from 'accounting@innovatech-dyn.com'.
GreenLeaf Organics paid Alex Chen $5,800 in 2023 for freelance writing, confirmed via bank statements, but did not issue a 1099-NEC.
Alex received a Form 1099-K from the platform GigSphere Connect showing gross payment transactions of $9,750 for 2023.
The GigSphere Connect 1099-K is located in the 'Tax Documents' section of the user dashboard at https://gigsphereconnect.com/user/tax.
Alex Chen earned $112.45 in taxable interest from a high-yield savings account at Pinnacle Trust Bank in 2023.
The Form 1099-INT from Pinnacle Trust Bank for account ending in ...5678 was mailed on January 22, 2024, and is also available online.
Quantum Leap Investments issued a consolidated Form 1099 for Alex's brokerage account (Acct# QL-90210) on February 15, 2024.
The 1099-DIV section of the Quantum Leap form shows $455.30 in qualified dividends for 2023.
The 1099-B section shows total proceeds from stock sales of $3,210.50 with a cost basis of $2,500.00.
Alex's login for Quantum Leap Investments requires two-factor authentication via the 'QL Authenticator' mobile app.
Alex contributed a total of $3,000 to a Health Savings Account (HSA) with HealthFirst Administrators in 2023.
HealthFirst Administrators issued Form 5498-SA to report the HSA contributions, available online since January 31, 2024.
A Form 1099-SA from HealthFirst Administrators shows total distributions of $850 for qualified medical expenses in 2023.
Alex paid $2,150 in student loan interest to EduFinance Servicing in 2023.
Form 1098-E from EduFinance Servicing is available under the 'Documents' tab of their portal, which required a password reset on January 10, 2024.
Alex made a cash donation of $500 to the 'Local Paws Animal Shelter' on December 15, 2023.
The donation receipt from Local Paws Animal Shelter was emailed on December 15, 2023, with transaction ID LPAS-DON-23-7890.
Alex spent $450 on an annual subscription to 'MarketAnalytics Pro' software, a business expense, charged to their credit card on March 1, 2023.
A new laptop for business use was purchased on July 10, 2023, from 'Circuit City Electronics' for $1,899.99.
The receipt for the business laptop is stored in Alex's email account in a folder named '2023 Tax Receipts'.
Alex Chen plans to file their 2023 federal and state taxes using 'TaxSwift Pro' software before the April 15, 2024 deadline.
Alex made a federal estimated tax payment of $2,000 for Q4 2023 on January 12, 2024, via the EFTPS.gov website.

user_needs.description: Where can I find my W-2 from Stellar Marketing Solutions and when was it made available?
What are the total wages and federal tax withheld shown on my W-2 from Stellar Marketing Solutions?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: After locating the W-2 form, the user will want to confirm the key financial figures on it.

user_needs.description: How did Innovatech Dynamics send my 1099-NEC and what was the total payment amount they reported?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After addressing their primary W-2 employment income, the user will logically move to gathering documents for their freelance income.

user_needs.description: Where can I find the tax form from GigSphere Connect and what type of form is it?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: After confirming one source of freelance income, the user will continue to the next known freelance platform to find the corresponding tax document.

user_needs.description: How much taxable interest did I earn from Pinnacle Trust Bank and how was the Form 1099-INT delivered?
What were the qualified dividends reported on my Quantum Leap Investments Form 1099-DIV?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After locating the tax form for their bank savings account, the user is likely to think about other financial accounts, such as their brokerage account.
